g.text: E014 integration gate: every fresh 16 GiB run must pass
Points are process minima, not confidence bounds. Short = N32 / N2048 × blocks 3 / 8; long = N32768 / N131072 × blocks 3 / 8.
Dashed thresholds: short ≥0.97×, long ≥1.10×. Focused y-ranges differ by panel. 2 GiB is a separate compatibility check.
Three 16 GiB gates = PASS / FAIL / PASS → overall adoption FAIL. No post-hoc rerun selection; default OFF.
